title: 第32章 夜半诡物敲门-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    五人的回答五花八门，只有谢辞一语中的。

    靳兰玦看向他：“你有记起来什么吗？”

    谢辞回视，眼神里有思考：“有闪过一些片段，基本都是在部队里训练的内容。”

    靳兰玦看向另外三人。

    他们一致点头。

    看来在这里面，他们的记忆会随着行动，渐渐有相应的恢复。

    只是目前看来，恢复的记忆内容，与他们此行依旧没有任何关系。

    苏怀瑾突然说：“是不是天黑了？”

    众人纷纷看向楼下大厅。

    光线似乎确实暗下来了，凉森森的空气让他们露在外面的皮肤汗毛直立。

    有窸窸窣窣的声音在脚下响起。

    靳兰玦眼神微动，看向楼梯口。

    木箱子里，纸张摩擦的声音逐渐清晰，周玉的声音像是被掐住脖子的惨叫鸡，压抑着音量：

    “啥东西？！那些东西活过来了？！”

    脚下大厅的光线肉眼可见的昏暗下来。

    靳兰玦示意众人上楼，低声：“走，上去。”

    几人压着脚步声，安安静静上楼。

    二楼的走廊长长的，可以明显看到外面的大槐树，昏暗中树影幢幢，靳兰玦立刻想到上个副本中的枯树诡物，不由多看了两眼。

    茂盛的大树在昏暗中安静伫立。

    只是短短十多秒，天色已经彻底黑暗，视线中几乎看不到其他的队友。

    一道微弱的光线在队伍最后亮起。

    谢辞点亮腕表，为大家提供了微弱的光线。

    靳兰玦在上楼的瞬间快速扫过走廊，一共就四个门。

    两扇粉色，两色蓝色。

    她猜这是男女孩儿的宿舍，于是低声提醒：

    “前面是男孩儿宿舍。”

    最前面的周玉也打亮自己的腕表，隔着雾蒙蒙的窗户往里面照。

    他低声说：“安全。”

    话落，扭动门把手，轻轻推开门板。

    “吱——”

    拉锯一样让人牙酸的声音划破安静的走廊，位于队伍中间的靳兰玦和苏怀瑾立刻回头。

    谢辞站在最后面，也回头去看，压低声音中有紧绷的情绪：“走。”

    身后的楼梯下方，纸张摩挲的沙沙声音越来越多。

    零碎的，细微的咔咔碰撞声音，像数不清的小纸人，走动间碰到了台阶，又互相推挤着，继续往上爬。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The answers from the five people were varied, but only the words of thanks hit the mark.

Jin Lanjue looked at him: "Do you remember anything?"

谢辞回视，眼神里有思考：“有闪过一些片段，基本都是在部队里训练的内容。”

Jin Lanjue looked at the other three people.

They nodded unanimously.

It seems that here, their memories will gradually be restored according to the actions.

But at present, it seems that the recovered memory content still has nothing to do with their trip.

Su Huaijin suddenly said: "Is it getting dark?"

Everyone looked towards the hall downstairs.

The light did seem to dim, and the cool air made the hairs on their exposed skin stand up.

There was a rustling sound under the feet.

Jin Lanjue's eyes moved slightly and looked towards the stairs.

In the wooden box, the sound of paper rubbing gradually became clearer, and Zhou Yu’s voice was like a squealing chicken being strangled by the neck, suppressing the volume:

"What?! Those things came to life?!"

The light in the hall below was dimming visibly to the naked eye.

Jin Lanjue motioned for everyone to go upstairs and whispered: "Let's go up."

Several people quietly went upstairs, suppressing the sound of footsteps.

The corridor on the second floor is long, and you can clearly see the big locust tree outside. With the shadows of the trees in the dimness, Jin Lanjue immediately thought of the dead tree in the previous dungeon and couldn't help but take a second look.

The lush trees stood quietly in the darkness.

In just over ten seconds, the sky was completely dark, and there were almost no other teammates in sight.

A faint light lit up at the end of the team.

The words of thanks lit up the watch and provided a weak light for everyone.

Jin Lanjue quickly scanned the corridor as he went upstairs. There were only four doors in total.

​ Two colors of pink and two colors of blue.

She guessed that this was a dormitory for boys and girls, so she reminded in a low voice:

“In front is the boys’ dormitory.”

Zhou Yu at the front also lit up his watch and looked inside through the foggy window.

He whispered: "Safe."

After finishing speaking, he twisted the door handle and gently pushed the door panel open.

"Squeak——"

A tooth-grinding sound like a saw cut through the quiet corridor, and Jin Lanjue and Su Huaijin, who were in the middle of the team, immediately turned around.

Xie Ci stood at the back and looked back. He lowered his voice and said nervously: "Let's go."

Behind me, at the bottom of the stairs, the rustling sound of paper was getting louder and louder.

Fragmented, subtle clicking sounds, like countless little paper figures, bumping into the steps while walking, pushing each other, and continuing to climb.
